recorded_by: the serving lane, on the corpus lane's delivery of V ledger v2 (2026-09-13)
what_v_is: An ANCHOR, not a lattice. It points from a base word to the commentary units whose opening catchword names that word, and from a verse to how much commentary sits on it. It has no opinion on what a comment says, and it does not hold the commentary's words: those are an uncarded token stream the corpus lane keeps elsewhere.

delivery.integrity: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt — 60 of 60 files verified on 2026-09-14, this lane's own run

counter_verified.says: Every one of the 21,686 anchored positions is an ON position of lattice v12, carries the reference and the surface the lattice gives it, and lands on a word this lane's own zone draws. j is unique and ascending; i repeats 12,230 times across maqaf parts in the eight books that carry an anchor, which is why the join is on book and i and j and never on i alone.
counter_verified.does_not_say: that a catchword names the word it resolved to. That is the corpus lane's resolution and its own recount's question, not this lane's.

why_nothing_is_served_yet: Two measured findings, neither of them a defect in V. V measures the corpus lane's 34 works; this site serves a different set, and the two do not meet where the page would need them to.

findings.measured_on: 2026-09-14, against the shipped reverse index and this lane's zone list
findings.says: Under the rule as it stands, 10,138 word-anchored pairs are spread over fourteen works. This lane holds the text of NONE of them. Rashi on Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers and Deuteronomy; Ibn Ezra on Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus and Numbers; Midrash Lekach Tov and its three small books; Midrash Tannaim on Deuteronomy; the GRA's Aderet Eliyahu. Not one is a zone on this shelf.
findings.cost: V's first sentence is 'N comments cover this word' and then opens them. This lane can count them and cannot open one. An offer a page cannot keep is worse than a silence that explains itself.
findings.works_this_lane_does_hold_that_v_names: Chizkuni, Mizrachi, Rabbeinu Bahya, Tur HaArokh, Ibn Ezra on Zechariah, Ralbag Esther, Shelom Esther and nine more — every one of them with zero word-anchored pairs, which V measured and did not assume: the sixteen TWO_INT works carry no markup at all.
findings.whose: the corpus lane's to deliver, or the owner's to rule that the word layer is served as a finding with no link

findings.measured_on: 2026-09-14, against the shipped book table and this lane's served commentary sidecars
findings.says: V's sixth sentence reads 'We hold no commentary on {BOOK}' and covers 213,459 positions, seven words in ten. V holds commentary on ten books. This site serves a commentary on eighteen of the twenty-nine it holds none on — Joshua, Judges, II Samuel, I Kings, Isaiah, Ezekiel, Hosea, Joel, Amos, Obadiah, Jonah, Micah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah, Haggai, Malachi, Song of Songs.
findings.cost: The page would tell a reader it holds no commentary on Amos while its own door offers 'Commentary on Amos, 146 carried from 1 work'. A page that contradicts itself inside one screen is the fault this project exists to make impossible.
findings.not_v_s_fault: V's 'we' is the corpus lane's 34 works. The sentence is true of what V measured. It is this lane's holdings it does not know about.
findings.whose: the owner's. The sentence is his to rule, and three readings are open: name the scope ('among the works the corpus lane has indexed'), fold this lane's own commentary into the count, or hold the sentence until the two sets are one.

the_owner: the wording of the sixth sentence, given that eighteen books contradict it as written
whether the word layer is served as a finding that names the work without offering to open it
the book display names: V ships book_display_name with status PROPOSED_PENDING_OWNER, on 213,459 positions
whether clause 13 (the framing trim) becomes the rule, strict or conservative. Candidate only; the switch is one filter and the tables carry all three positions
the_corpus_lane: the text of the fourteen word-anchoring works, if the word layer is ever to open a comment rather than name one

what_this_lane_will_not_do: Serve a count it cannot open, print a sentence its own door contradicts, or name a book by a slug or by a name of its own. V ships the display name; the owner rules it; the page prints what he rules.
